purpose: carry population-level predictive value of adding information layers into N3 without promoting an axis-resolved state object or ranking survey locations

value_fields.conservative_mean_value: max(0, lower bound of population mean interval)
value_fields.positive_group_fraction: observed fraction of independent groups above the declared gain tolerance
value_fields.positive_fraction_lower: source-reported lower bound retained with its method label
value_fields.prediction_interval: source-reported labelled new-group prediction interval when available

downstream_boundary.n3_may: combine transfer value with EOG world/reachability structure and preserve uncertainty
n3_may_not: reinterpret the payload as an axis-resolved state artifact
infer a state map from transfer value alone
rank spatial survey patches directly from this payload

compatibility.relationship: parallel payload families with non-overlapping semantics
